description: Rules governing when authority over a shadow governance document or section may be promoted to the FORGE Governance Synchronizer.
rules: Promotion applies only to explicitly approved documents or sections.
Successful performance in one document does not grant authority over another document.
Successful performance in one section does not grant authority over another section.
The synchronizer may recommend promotion but may not approve promotion.
Only the owner may approve, revoke, suspend, or restore synchronizer authority.
Any serious governance failure resets the evaluation period for the affected scope.
The roadmap remains human-controlled unless explicitly promoted by the owner.
